# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We currently only provide security updates for the latest major version.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.3.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 2.3.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **DO NOT** report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues. 

Instead, please send an email or contact the repository owner privately.
We will try to acknowledge your report within 48 hours and work with you to patch the vulnerability.

We take security seriously, especially since WinDeck is a remote control tool for PC automation. 
Thank you for helping us keep our community safe!
